items.note: A full-bleed yellow hero band holds a regular-weight display title, a centered lead and one pink CTA. Four tilted sticker shapes are cropped at the band's edges: a coin, a tag, a star and a plus-coin. Below it on paper sit a 1px-ink outlined featured card, a search field with an attached icon button, filter pills ("All" is selected) and a 3-column grid of outlined post cards. It reads like the reference: paper, ink and one loud pink with a flooded color header.

The band collapses to the title, lead and pink CTA, and the filter pills become a horizontally scrolling strip (the last pill is cut by design). The cards stack in one column with even 16px gutters. Only two small slivers of sticker show in the band's corners, so the hero loses most of its sticker character at this width.

The yellow band and its stickers stay the same over a black ground with ink text. The selected pill flips to paper and the cards are dark raised surfaces with light 1px borders. The pink CTA and the "Showing" count tag are the only pink. Hierarchy and spacing match the light theme and every text node is readable.

The dark theme matches mobile light: a collapsed yellow band, a scrolling pill strip, stacked dark-raised outlined cards and a full-width pink subscribe button. All text on the band is ink. The same corner slivers of sticker art carry the whole hero.

Same-section yellow header band with an ink breadcrumb, a 3xl regular-weight title, a meta line and outlined tag pills. Below it, a narrow article column with an "On this page" list on the right, a sticker-color image placeholder (yellow with an ink glyph) in a 1px ink frame, a quote with a left rule, and a code well. Related posts sit in outlined cards. The band is correctly the only color and there is no sticker in the page header.

The band carries the breadcrumb, title, meta and tag pills in ink. "On this page" becomes a horizontal pill strip. The code block scrolls inside its own bordered box instead of widening the page. Related cards stack in one column and the newsletter form follows. Nothing overflows the 390px page.

The yellow band stays in ink over a black ground and its tag pills invert to dark fills with light text. The article, on-this-page list, dark code well and image placeholder keep the light-theme layout. Body text is light on black and readable, and the related cards are dark-raised with thin light borders.

Mobile dark article: yellow band header, a scrolling on-this-page strip, single-column body copy with a quote rule, an internally scrolling code box and stacked outlined related cards. Spacing rhythm matches mobile light and nothing is cut off.

The same article layout under the shared yellow band: a 60ch body column, a right-hand on-this-page list, a code well with the template, a yellow image placeholder with an ink frame, and a numbered checklist. Related posts sit in three outlined cards. h2 and h3 sizes step clearly and the band title leads the page.

The band wraps the title onto two lines with the meta and two tag pills below. The on-this-page strip scrolls sideways and the code block clips inside its box with internal scroll. The list, quote and image placeholder keep a 16px gutter, and the related cards stack cleanly.

Dark article with the yellow band in ink. Tag pills are dark-filled in the band, and the code well and related cards are dark-raised with light 1px borders. The only pink is the subscribe button at the foot, and hierarchy matches light.

Mobile dark keeps the collapsed band, the scrolling on-this-page strip, an internally scrolling code box, the yellow image placeholder and stacked related cards. All text is readable against its fill.

This section owns a periwinkle band (a different section from the posts' yellow) with an ink title and lead. Below it, a "Why we write" text column with an underlined secondary link, and a small pink star sticker beside "The authors" heading. Three outlined author cards use square ink-framed initials. A short, calm page that keeps one band color and one small sticker.

The band collapses to the title and a two-line lead. The body copy and the underlined link sit on paper. The author cards stack with square initials boxes, and the newsletter card ends with a full-width pink subscribe button. Spacing is consistent and nothing is cramped.

The periwinkle band keeps ink text over a black ground, and the selected "About" nav pill flips to paper. The author cards are dark-raised with light-bordered initials boxes and the star sticker keeps its outline. Readable and consistent with light.

Mobile dark About: a periwinkle band, light body text with an underlined link, a pink star sticker beside the heading, stacked dark author cards and a full-width pink subscribe button. Gutters are even and nothing overflows.

findings.summary: On mobile the landing hero keeps only two tiny corner slivers of its sticker shapes, so the sticker hero all but disappears and the band reads as a plain colored header.
